premises.text: Organizations rely on more contractors and vendors than full-time employees, but finding, engaging, and collaborating with them via shouts, emails, spreadsheets, and scattered document apps is messy and inefficient
premises.evidence_span: This whole workflow process between companies to outsource parties is a complete mess and super inefficient

premises.text: Listable provides a searchable internal contractor index with flexible onboarding templates and forms shared by link
premises.evidence_span: All of their contributor network information, past and future, will be stored in one place, accessible by all of their employees

premises.text: Projects create a dual private/shared tracking interface with object-based email-integrated communication across team and contributors
premises.evidence_span: it will create this dual project tracking interface

premises.text: After projects, Listable auto-requests internal feedback and contributor invoices, then supports approving and distributing payments across many countries
premises.evidence_span: we will auto-request feedback from all the team members that have worked with Patrick

premises.text: SaaS freemium model so any company can sign up and use Listable for free
premises.evidence_span: we're a SaaS company with a freemium model

domains.name: onboard manage communicate and pay contributors

value.text: Companies can efficiently onboard, manage, communicate with, and pay large contributor and contractor networks in one place
value.evidence_span: onboard, manage, communicate with, and pay these huge contributor networks
